title: Activity Dashboard for Compliance and Collections
description: This project showcases a dynamic task management dashboard built using Google Sheets and Google Forms. It was designed to streamline daily workload tracking in a compliance and collections environment.
alt: Activity Dashboard for Compliance & Collections Thumbnail

title: Collections Escalation Workflow
description: A visual decision-making workflow that standardizes the review and escalation of past-due accounts. By transforming a complex operational process into a clear, repeatable guide, it improves consistency, collaboration, and onboarding across teams.

title: Virtual Numbers Regulatory Database
description: A centralized knowledge base that consolidates country-specific regulations, documentation requirements, and supplier information into a single searchable resource, enabling support teams to respond to customer inquiries faster and with greater accuracy.

title: QA Evaluation Form Project
description: Designed and developed a comprehensive QA Evaluation Form used to assess the quality of email and chat interactions for a customer support team. The form incorporates weighted scoring, N/A logic, and structured coaching documentation to ensure fair evaluations and improve agent performance.

title: Regulatory Compliance Specialization Projects
description: Throughout the Regulatory Compliance Specialization offered by the University of Pennsylvania via Coursera, I completed four projects that demonstrate my ability to identify risks, analyze compliance requirements, and design effective mitigation strategies.
